GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

5. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   D. Treat Soils as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   D. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

8. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.

9. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

10. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   C. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

13. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

15. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   B. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
